## general setup across 18 lists

```{r check: exposure condition, Latin-square order and key position}

list_check_table <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  #checkpoint 1: exposure condition
  expo_condition_val <- list.df %>% 
    filter(block %in% c("2", "4", "6")) %>% 
    pull(condition) %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    na.omit() %>% 
    paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  #checkpoint 2: Latin-square order
  expo_order_seq <- list.df %>% 
    filter(block %in% c("2", "4", "6")) %>% 
    distinct(block, blockID) %>% 
    arrange(block) %>% 
    pull(blockID) %>% 
    paste(collapse = "")
  
  #checkpoint 3: key options for unlabeled trials
  unlabeled_left <- list.df %>% 
    filter(label == "unlabeled") %>% 
    pull(left) %>% unique() %>% na.omit() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  unlabeled_right <- list.df %>% 
    filter(label == "unlabeled") %>% 
    pull(right) %>% unique() %>% na.omit() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  #checkpoint 4: key options for labeled trials
  labeled_left <- list.df %>% 
    filter(label == "labeled") %>% 
    pull(left) %>% unique() %>% na.omit() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  labeled_right <- list.df %>% 
    filter(label == "labeled") %>% 
    pull(right) %>% unique() %>% na.omit() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  #checkpoint 5: number of practice, exposure, catch, and test trials
  practice_count <- list.df %>% 
    filter(display == "practice") %>% 
    nrow()
  
  exposure_count <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "exposure") %>% 
    nrow()
  
  catch_count <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "catch") %>% 
    nrow()
  
  test_count <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "test") %>% 
    nrow()
  
  main_total_count = exposure_count + catch_count + test_count
  
  current_check <- tibble(
    Filename = filename,
    Expo_Condition = expo_condition_val,
    LSQ_order = expo_order_seq,
    Unlabeled_Left = unlabeled_left,
    Unlabeled_Right = unlabeled_right,
    Labeled_Left = labeled_left,
    Labeled_Right = labeled_right,
    Practice_Count = practice_count,
    Exposure_Count = exposure_count,
    Catch_Count = catch_count,
    Test_Count = test_count,
    Total_Count = main_total_count
  )
  
  list_check_table <- bind_rows(list_check_table, current_check)
}

list_check_table <- list_check_table %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(list_check_table)

```

## Exposure blocks

```{r exposure blocks structure, echo=FALSE}

exposure_check_table <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  get_block_metrics <- function(df, block_num) {
    block_df <- df %>% filter(block == as.character(block_num))
    
    total       <- nrow(block_df)
    exposure    <- sum(block_df$trial_type == "exposure", na.rm = TRUE)
    catch       <- sum(block_df$trial_type == "catch", na.rm = TRUE)
    
    d_labeled   <- sum(block_df$label == "labeled" & str_starts(block_df$word, "d"), na.rm = TRUE)
    t_labeled   <- sum(block_df$label == "labeled" & str_starts(block_df$word, "t"), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    d_unlabeled <- sum(block_df$label == "unlabeled" & str_starts(block_df$word, "d"), na.rm = TRUE)
    t_unlabeled <- sum(block_df$label == "unlabeled" & str_starts(block_df$word, "t"), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    return(list(
      total = total,
      exposure = exposure,
      catch = catch,
      d_labeled = d_labeled,
      t_labeled = t_labeled,
      d_unlabeled = d_unlabeled,
      t_unlabeled = t_unlabeled
    ))
  }
  
  b2 <- get_block_metrics(list.df, 2)
  b4 <- get_block_metrics(list.df, 4)
  b6 <- get_block_metrics(list.df, 6)
  
  current_check <- tibble(
    Filename = filename,
    
    block2_total         = b2$total,
    block2_exposure      = b2$exposure,
    block2_catch         = b2$catch,
    block2_d_labeled     = b2$d_labeled,
    block2_t_labeled     = b2$t_labeled,
    block2_d_unlabeled   = b2$d_unlabeled,
    block2_t_unlabeled   = b2$t_unlabeled,
    
    block4_total         = b4$total,
    block4_exposure      = b4$exposure,
    block4_catch         = b4$catch,
    block4_d_labeled     = b4$d_labeled,
    block4_t_labeled     = b4$t_labeled,
    block4_d_unlabeled   = b4$d_unlabeled,
    block4_t_unlabeled   = b4$t_unlabeled,
    
    block6_total         = b6$total,
    block6_exposure      = b6$exposure,
    block6_catch         = b6$catch,
    block6_d_labeled     = b6$d_labeled,
    block6_t_labeled     = b6$t_labeled,
    block6_d_unlabeled   = b6$d_unlabeled,
    block6_t_unlabeled   = b6$t_unlabeled
  )
  
  exposure_check_table <- bind_rows(exposure_check_table, current_check)
}

exposure_check_table <- exposure_check_table %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(exposure_check_table)

```

```{r VOT distribution across exposure conditions, echo=FALSE}

vot_stats_table <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  stats_summary <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "exposure") %>% 
    mutate(VOT = as.numeric(VOT)) %>% 
    group_by(token_category) %>% 
    summarise(
      Mean_VOT = mean(VOT, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_VOT   = sd(VOT, na.rm = TRUE),
      Trial_Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stats_wide <- stats_summary %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = token_category,
      values_from = c(Mean_VOT, SD_VOT, Trial_Count),
      names_glue = "{token_category}_{.value}"
    )
  
  current_check <- tibble(Filename = filename) %>% 
    bind_cols(stats_wide)
  
  vot_stats_table <- bind_rows(vot_stats_table, current_check)
}

vot_stats_table <- vot_stats_table %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(vot_stats_table)

```

```{r histograms for VOT distributions, echo=FALSE}
raw_plot_data <- tibble()

#VOT distrbution by blocks
for (file_path in all_files) {
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  list_id   <- as.numeric(str_extract(filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))
  expo_cond <- str_extract(filename, "(?<=expo)[+-]?\\d+ms")
  expo_seq  <- str_extract(filename, "(?<=ms_)[A-Z]{3}")
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  expo_df <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "exposure") %>% 
    mutate(VOT = as.numeric(VOT))
  
  expo_df <- expo_df %>% 
    mutate(material = case_when(
      block == "2" ~ substr(expo_seq, 1, 1),
      block == "4" ~ substr(expo_seq, 2, 2),
      block == "6" ~ substr(expo_seq, 3, 3),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  cleaned_df <- expo_df %>% 
    select(VOT, token_category, label, material) %>% 
    mutate(
      expo_cond = expo_cond,
      list_id = list_id
    )
  
  raw_plot_data <- bind_rows(raw_plot_data, cleaned_df)
}

#overall distribution
plot_data_all <- raw_plot_data %>% 
  mutate(material = "all")

combined_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  raw_plot_data %>% mutate(material = paste("Exposure materials", material)),
  plot_data_all
)

combined_plot_data <- combined_plot_data %>% 
  mutate(
    expo_cond = factor(expo_cond, levels = c("-20ms", "-10ms", "+20ms")),
    material  = factor(material, levels = c("Exposure materials A", "Exposure materials B", "Exposure materials C", "all")),
    stimulus_type = case_when(
      token_category == "d" & label == "labeled"   ~ "/d/ labeled",
      token_category == "d" & label == "unlabeled" ~ "/d/ unlabeled",
      token_category == "t" & label == "labeled"   ~ "/t/ labeled",
      token_category == "t" & label == "unlabeled" ~ "/t/ unlabeled"
    ),
    stimulus_type = factor(stimulus_type, levels = c("/d/ labeled", "/d/ unlabeled", "/t/ labeled", "/t/ unlabeled")),
    fill_group = paste(expo_cond, token_category, label, sep = "_")
  )

color_mapping <- c(
  "-20ms_d_labeled"   = "#6b2021",
  "-20ms_d_unlabeled" = "#f2a4a6",
  "-20ms_t_labeled"   = "#c93237",
  "-20ms_t_unlabeled" = "#fde9ea",
  
  "-10ms_d_labeled"   = "#1b6338",
  "-10ms_d_unlabeled" = "#9adbb3",
  "-10ms_t_labeled"   = "#27a75a",
  "-10ms_t_unlabeled" = "#e7f6ed",
  
  "+20ms_d_labeled"   = "#175487",
  "+20ms_d_unlabeled" = "#9bcff2",
  "+20ms_t_labeled"   = "#2185c5",
  "+20ms_t_unlabeled" = "#e6f3fc"
)

#mean and SD information
annotations <- tibble(
  expo_cond = factor(c("-20ms", "-10ms", "+20ms"), levels = c("-20ms", "-10ms", "+20ms")),
  material  = factor("all", levels = c("Exposure materials A", "Exposure materials B", "Exposure materials C", "all")),
  x = 40,
  y = 20,
  label_text = c(
    "μ_d = 5,  σ_d = 8.9\nμ_t = 50, σ_t = 16.4",
    "μ_d = 15,  σ_d = 8.9\nμ_t = 60, σ_t = 16.4",
    "μ_d = 45,  σ_d = 8.9\nμ_t = 90, σ_t = 16.4"
  )
)

p <- ggplot(combined_plot_data) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(x = VOT, y = after_stat(count / 6), fill = fill_group),
    binwidth = 5,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = color_mapping,
    breaks = c("-20ms_d_labeled", "-20ms_d_unlabeled", "-20ms_t_labeled", "-20ms_t_unlabeled"),

    fill = guide_legend(

  labs(
    x = "VOT (ms)",
    y = "Count (per participant)",
    fill = "Stimulus type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    aspect.ratio = 0.85
  )

p
```

## Test blocks

#1. all 12 VOT locations need to appear in each block
```{r VOT check, echo=FALSE}

expected_vots <- c(-5, 5, 15, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 65, 70)

test_check.1 <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  test_df <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "test") %>% 
    mutate(VOT = as.numeric(VOT))
  
    block_summary <- test_df %>% 
    group_by(blockID) %>% 
    summarise(
      trial_count = n(),
      vot_match = identical(sort(unique(VOT)), expected_vots),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  block_summary_wide <- block_summary %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = blockID,
      values_from = c(trial_count, vot_match),
      names_glue = "{blockID}_{.value}"
    )
  
  current_check <- tibble(Filename = filename) %>% 
    bind_cols(block_summary_wide)
  
  test_check.1 <- bind_rows(test_check.1, current_check)
}

test_check.1 <- test_check.1 %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(test_check.1)

```

#2. each minimal pair appears four times in each block
```{r minimal pair check, echo=FALSE}

test_check.2 <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  test_df <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "test")
  
  pair_summary <- test_df %>% 
    group_by(blockID, word) %>% 
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  pair_summary_wide <- pair_summary %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = c(blockID, word),
      values_from = count,
      names_glue = "{blockID}_{word}"
    )
  
  all_perfect <- nrow(pair_summary) == 18 && all(pair_summary$count == 4)
  
  current_check <- tibble(Filename = filename) %>% 
    bind_cols(pair_summary_wide) %>% 
    mutate(All_Perfect = all_perfect)
  
  test_check.2 <- bind_rows(test_check.2, current_check)
}

test_check.2 <- test_check.2 %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(test_check.2)

```

#3. each minimal pair appear with each VOT equally often (twice) across all six test blocks (and no more than once per test block)
```{r minimal pair check, echo=FALSE}

test_check.3 <- tibble()

for (file_path in all_files) {
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  
  list.df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  test_df <- list.df %>% 
    filter(trial_type == "test") %>% 
    mutate(VOT = as.numeric(VOT))
  
  overall_cooccur <- test_df %>% 
    group_by(word, VOT) %>% 
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  num_combinations <- nrow(overall_cooccur)
  min_count <- if(num_combinations > 0) min(overall_cooccur$count) else 0
  max_count <- if(num_combinations > 0) max(overall_cooccur$count) else 0
  all_exactly_2 <- num_combinations == 36 && min_count == 2 && max_count == 2
  
  overall_status <- if (all_exactly_2) {
    "TRUE"
  } else {
    paste0("Error (Total combinations: ", num_combinations, ", Range: ", min_count, "-", max_count, ")")
  }
  
  block_cooccur <- test_df %>% 
    group_by(blockID, word, VOT) %>% 
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  max_block_count <- if(nrow(block_cooccur) > 0) max(block_cooccur$count) else 0
  no_dup_in_block <- max_block_count <= 1
  
  block_status <- if (no_dup_in_block) {
    "TRUE"
  } else {
    paste0("Error (Max duplicate count = ", max_block_count, ")")
  }
  
  current_check <- tibble(
    Filename = filename,
    token_two_repetition_across_block = overall_status,
    no_duplicate_within_block = block_status
  )
  
  test_check.3 <- bind_rows(test_check.3, current_check)
}

test_check.3 <- test_check.3 %>% 
  mutate(list_id = as.numeric(str_extract(Filename, "(?<=List_)\\d+"))) %>% 
  arrange(list_id) %>% 
  select(-list_id)

view(test_check.3)

```
